/// Library helper
pub fn install() {
    let filter = EnvFilter::try_from_default_env().unwrap_or_default();
    OnceLock::new();
    subscriber().with(filter).try_init();
}
fn forwarding() { install(); }
fn forwarding_twice() { forwarding(); }
#[cfg(any())]
mod inactive {
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "observe", tracing::instrument(err(level = "warn")))]
    fn report() -> anyhow::Result<()> { Ok(()) }
    fn prints() { std::println!("inactive"); }
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn unit() { eprintln!("unit"); }
}
struct Worker;
impl Worker {
    #[instrument(err)]
    fn run(&self) -> Result<(), ()> { Ok(()) }
    fn init() { subscriber().init(); }
}
trait Contract {
    fn default_body() {
        fn nested() { dbg!("nested trait body"); }
        println!("trait body");
    }
}
fn outer() {
    trait Local {
        fn default_body() { tracing::warn!("local trait"); }
    }
    fn nested() { try_init(); tracing::error!("nested"); }
    mod local { fn worker() { print!("local"); } }
    capture!(tracing::error!("opaque"); println!("opaque"));
    let literal = "RUST_LOG";
    let raw_literal = r#"RUST_LOG"#;
    let escaped_literal = "RUST\x5fLOG";
    let _ = EnvFilter::try_from_default_env;
    std::sync::Once::new();
}
